nodes.label: Shoppers
nodes.what: The people who use the shop: a `person` card is drawn as a person.

nodes.label: Support staff
nodes.what: People outside the system: a `user` card is external, and drawn as a person.

nodes.label: Storefront
nodes.what: A `frontend` card: a browser app, its title bar and address field over the card.

nodes.label: Shop app
nodes.what: A `mobile` card: a phone on its side.

nodes.label: Back office
nodes.what: Its own `shape`, a window: a card's `shape` wins over its kind.

nodes.label: Shop API
nodes.what: A `backend` card: no shape says more, so it is a rounded box with its kind's mark.

nodes.label: Support agent
nodes.what: An `agent` card: a robot (UML's non-human actor).

nodes.label: Order queue
nodes.what: A `queue` card: a pipe, open where the work leaves.

nodes.label: policies.md
nodes.what: A `file` card: a page with its corner folded (UML's artifact).

nodes.label: Hosts
nodes.what: A `cloud` card: a box seen in perspective (UML's node).

nodes.label: Payments
nodes.what: Outside the system: an `external` card is dashed.

views.title: Card shapes
views.caption: The one card-shape style: a shape for each kind that has one, a rounded box for the rest.
